title: The Burning Choir Again
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Wendell Ishikawa, a thief who steals memories, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
